# D'Krisna - Centro de Belleza y Bienestar

> Beauty and wellness salon in Caravaca de la Cruz, Murcia, Spain.

## About

D'Krisna is a professional beauty salon offering nail services (manicure, pedicure, gel nails, acrylic nails, softgel, polygel), brow and lash treatments (lamination, lifting, extensions), relaxing and therapeutic massages (including hot stone massage and Kobido facial lifting), and wood therapy body treatments (maderoterapia).

## Location

- Address: Carretera de Murcia N45, 30400 Caravaca de la Cruz, Murcia, Spain
- Phone: +34 722 27 59 75
- Email: dkrisnanails@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00–21:00. Closed on Sundays.

## Services

### Nail Services (Manicura)
- Gel nails, acrylic nails, softgel, polygel extensions
- Semi-permanent polish, dipping system
- Traditional manicure and cleanup
- Acrylic and gel refills

### Pedicure (Pedicura)
- Dry pedicure with traditional or semi-permanent polish
- Spa pedicure with exfoliation and hydration

### Brows & Lashes (Cejas y Pestañas)
- Eyebrow lamination and pigmentation
- Lash lifting and point-by-point extensions
- Facial waxing

### Massages (Masajes)
- Relaxing body massage with natural oils
- Geothermal hot stone massage
- Kobido facial lifting

### Wood Therapy (Maderoterapia)
- Facial wood therapy with phototherapy
- Legs and glutes contouring
- Abdomen, waist, and arms sculpting
- Full body treatment
- Session packages available (6 and 10 sessions)
